first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down and prior evidence shows simplification can improve activation and time-to-value, but it increased churn in complex-workspace accounts. Verify the segmented onboarding result and activation impact, then run a guarded test limited to suitable self-serve accounts while preserving the full flow for complex workspaces. Avoid promotional pricing because its prior acquisition lift materially reduced retention.

final.rationale: Use the weekly slot on in-product activation messaging. The verified result directly addresses the 6% activation decline, improving week-one engagement by 11%, activation by 6%, and 30-day retention by 1%, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Run a standard experiment with appropriate holdout measurement. Do not simplify onboarding for complex-workspace accounts because the verified flow increased 60-day churn there by 9%; preserve the full flow for that segment.
